ceu: ✦ The trine between the Sun and Mars

t: Today your heart pulls you indoors. A quiet dinner or some tidying at home will do you good.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up conversations, contacts and short trips.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your image and romance: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. A small gesture can have a big effect today.
s.d: Phone an older relative and listen to them without hurry.

s.k: Curiosity switched on: ask, listen, learn.
t: With the Moon in your house of communication, a word said at the right moment can clear up a misunderstanding.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your money and what you value.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your inner life and family: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Be thankful for what goes well and say it out loud.
s.d: Learn a new word or a new thing today, out of curiosity.

s.k: A day to sort out what really matters to you.
t: The Moon lights up what you have and what you are worth. A day to value your work and your time.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your image and your personal energy.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, friendships and conversations: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Let things flow without forcing them.
s.d: Cook a meal you love at home and savour it slowly.

s.k: Your presence speaks for itself today.
t: Your sign welcomes the Moon and your mood may swing more than usual. Give yourself time and do not take everything to heart.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up rest and your inner life.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your career and money: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Put your heart and your head on the same side.
s.d: Keep away from people who drain your energy, even if only for a day.

t: The Moon passes through your most private area and asks for retreat. Slowing down today is not wasting time.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up friends and plans for the future.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, your horizons and your image: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a day for sowing: what you do today grows over time.
s.d: Write down last night's dreams as soon as you wake up.

s.k: The right friends make all the difference.
t: Today a group, an association or a friend may bring you a new idea. Stay open.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up your career and your goals.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, intimacy and your inner life: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use it to take a step you keep putting off.
s.d: Step away from a group that only brings you down.

s.k: A day to show what you are worth.
t: With the Moon at the highest point of your sky, it is a good day for career decisions with both feet on the ground.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up study, travel and broad horizons.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, relationships and friendships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Accept whatever help comes along, wherever it comes from.
s.d: Thank those who helped you get where you are.

s.k: Faith in the path opens the path.
t: The Moon widens your vision. What looked like a problem today may turn into a lesson.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up intimacy and what you share with others.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, routine and your career: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. It is a good moment to bring the two together in a single plan.
s.d: Look up a place you would like to visit.

s.k: What runs deep asks for truth.
t: It is a day of quiet transformation. What ends today leaves room for something truer.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up relationships and partnerships.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, romance and your horizons: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Use this good energy to sort out what had stalled.
s.d: Forgive someone in your heart, even without telling them.

s.k: Together you go further than alone.
t: The Moon passes through your opposite sign and puts other people at the centre of the day. Today listening is worth more than talking.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up routine, daily work and health.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, family and intimacy: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Doors open more easily when you ask clearly.
s.d: Suggest a plan for the two of you this week.

s.k: Your body is asking for attention: listen to it.
t: Today your body speaks louder. Drink water, take breaks and do not ignore tiredness.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up pleasure, creativity and romance.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, conversations and relationships: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. An idea from today could become a real project.
s.d: Help a colleague with something small: it comes back to you twice over.

s.k: Let joy in without asking permission.
t: With the Moon in your house of joy, creativity flows. Give shape to an idea you have been keeping to yourself.
Until {H:1807511515000}, the Moon is still in {S:2} and stirs up home and family.

The trine between the Sun and Mars brings together, in your favour, money and routine: the Sun brings willpower and visibility, Mars brings courage and initiative. Trust what you are building: today the sky lends a hand.
s.d: Surprise someone you love, even if it is just a note.
